# AD Benchmark Fixtures

Professional audio description VTT files for VN-PROD-005 quality benchmarking.
All sourced from Able Player (ableplayer/ableplayer on GitHub) unless noted.

| File | Title | Source | Duration | License | Notes |
|------|-------|--------|----------|---------|-------|
| `deadline_descriptions_en.vtt` | The Deadline | Morevna Project / Able Player | ~53 sec | CC BY 4.0 | Animation, dense action |
| `wwa_description_en.vtt` | World Wide Access | DO-IT, Univ. of Washington | ~39 sec | Public domain | Interview/documentary, sparse AD |
| `itaccess_description_en.vtt` | IT Accessibility: What Campus Leaders Have to Say | DO-IT, Univ. of Washington | ~5 min | Public domain | Interview/documentary, sparse AD |
| `blocks4all_descriptions_en.vtt` | Blocks4All | AccessCSForAll / NSF | ~2.7 min | NSF-funded, free use | Mixed narration + visual description |
| `k_descriptions_en.vtt` | K | DO-IT, Univ. of Washington | ~2 min | Public domain | Montage, character-focused |

## Coverage gaps to fill

- No 5–15 min narrative fiction with dense AD
- Blender open films (Sintel, Big Buck Bunny) have no professional VTT — YouDescribe dataset is community-written
- NFB short films have professional AD but require research access request
- LSMDC dataset requires NDA
